_: NOTES-FROM-PLANNING.md entry 148 section 3: the Discord invite is written down in exactly one place, so replacing
it later is a single edit and no published link ever breaks.
Everything published points at the canonical address, grouplab.org/discord, which redirects to the invite. The
invite itself appears on no page and in no document: only in this file and in the redirect the build makes from it.
A test fails if the invite is written out anywhere else.
